verdict.rationale: Close documents a public REST API with full endpoint references, schemas, examples, and an interactive explorer. It also covers API-key and OAuth 2.0 auth, rate-limit headers, and a maintained changelog, and publishes an OpenAPI spec that a probe confirmed is live. AI-agent-friendly docs (llms.txt, .md pages) further support driving the product programmatically. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of real API usage beyond the spec and llms.txt probes.
